entities.summary: Achaemenid, a notable figure in the history of Türkiye, associated with Classical and Roman Anatolia (546 BCE–133 BCE). Preceded by Persian and Hellenistic Anatolia. Their legacy influenced Alexander the Great cuts the Gordian Knot at Gordium and Roman Empire.
